questions.prompt: A VM already has encrypted managed disks. The requirement now includes its temporary disk and host caches. Which VM feature addresses that scope?

options.explanation: Host encryption covers storage on the VM host in addition to the managed-disk path.

options.text: Only the existing managed-disk server-side encryption setting
options.explanation: Managed-disk encryption alone does not establish encryption of all host storage.
Secure Boot validates the boot chain; it is not disk-cache encryption.
HTTPS protects network connections, not host storage at rest.

questions.prompt: A VM previously used Azure Disk Encryption. An administrator wants to enable encryption at host on that same VM. What does the documented restriction require them to recognize?

options.text: That VM history is incompatible with enabling encryption at host directly.
options.explanation: The restriction covers VMs that currently or ever had Azure Disk Encryption enabled.

options.text: Disabling Secure Boot always removes the restriction.
options.explanation: Secure Boot does not remove the Azure Disk Encryption compatibility restriction.

options.text: Switching only the data disk to Standard HDD always removes the restriction.
options.explanation: Changing disk performance tier does not change the VM encryption history rule.

options.text: Enabling both methods together is required.
options.explanation: The two encryption methods cannot be combined in this way.

questions.prompt: Which setting directly confirms that encryption at host is enabled on a VM after the supported configuration process?

options.explanation: This is the VM host-encryption property.

options.text: The disk reports ordinary server-side encryption
options.explanation: Managed disks can report encryption while host encryption is disabled.

options.text: The VM uses SSH public-key authentication
options.explanation: Authentication does not report encryption of host storage.

options.text: The VM has a Recovery Services backup item
options.explanation: Backup protection does not establish the host-encryption setting.
